goa.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
goa.description: The Basilica of Bom Jesus (Portuguese: Basílica do Bom Jesus; Goan Konkani: Borea Jezuchi Bajilika) is a Catholic basilica in Goa, in the Konkan region of India. The church is a pilgrimage centre and recognised by UNESCO as a World Heritage Site. The
goa.address: Basilica of Bom Jesus, Panaji - Ribandar - Old Goa Road, Ella, Old Goa, Panaji, Tiswadi, North Goa, Goa, 403108, India
goa.audio_guide_text: Welcome to the Basilica of Bom Jesus, where the saint's relics rest beneath a dazzling altar. Notice the intricate gold leaf work that reflects Goa's Portuguese legacy.

goa.name: Se Cathedral
goa.description: The Sé Catedral de Santa Catarina, known as Se Cathedral, is the cathedral of the Latin Church Archdiocese of Goa and Daman and the seat of the Patriarch of the East Indies. It is part of the World Heritage Site, Churches and convents of Goa located
goa.address: Se Cathedral, Diwar Ferry Road, Ella, Old Goa, Panaji, Tiswadi, North Goa, Goa, 403108, India
goa.audio_guide_text: Standing before Se Cathedral, you see a monumental blend of Gothic and Tuscan styles. Inside, the massive nave and the historic Golden Bell echo centuries of maritime glory.

goa.name: Old Goa Churches Cluster
goa.description: A compact UNESCO heritage zone that includes Bom Jesus, Se Cathedral, St. Cajetan and the ruins of St. Augustine within a 1 km radius. The area showcases the zenith of Portuguese religious architecture in India.
goa.audio_guide_text: Explore Old Goa's four historic churches, each narrating a chapter of colonial Goa. Listen for the echo of Portuguese chants that once filled these sacred halls.

goa.name: Chapora Fort
goa.description: Chapora Fort (Konkani pronunciation: [ʃɑːpoːɾɑː], Devanagari: शापोरा), located in Bardez, Goa, rises high above the Chapora River. The site is the location of a fort built by Adil Shahi dynasty ruler Adil Shah and  called Shahpoora, whose name was al
goa.address: Chapora Fort, Chapora Jetty Road, Dabhol Vaddo, Anjuna, Chapora, Bardez, North Goa, Goa, 403519, India
goa.audio_guide_text: From the ramparts of Chapora Fort, the Arabian Sea stretches to the horizon. The stone walls whisper stories of Portuguese defense and later Indian battles.

goa.name: Aguada Lighthouse
goa.description: Located inside the 17th‑century Aguada Fort, this working lighthouse was erected in 1864 to guide ships into the Mandovi River. Climbing its spiral stairs rewards visitors with 360° coastal views.
goa.address: Light House Aguada, Fort Aguada Road, Nerul, Sinquerim, Bardez, North Goa, Goa, 403515, India
goa.audio_guide_text: The Aguada Lighthouse stands as a beacon of maritime heritage, its light once warning colonial vessels. Ascend the stairs for an unrivaled vista of Sinquerim, Calangute and the Mandovi mouth.

goa.name: Dona Paula Viewpoint
goa.description: A scenic headland where the Mandovi and Zuari rivers meet the Arabian Sea, famed for its sunset panoramas and the romantic legend of Dona Paula. It also serves as a launch point for water‑sports.
goa.audio_guide_text: At Dona Paula, the confluence of two rivers creates a shimmering mirror for the setting sun. The legend of the 'damsel of Dona Paula' adds a touch of romance to the view.

goa.name: Panaji Portuguese Quarter
goa.description: The historic Fontainhas district of Panaji, a UNESCO‑listed heritage zone with pastel‑coloured Indo‑Portuguese houses, narrow lanes and the charming São Tomé Chapel. It reflects Goa’s unique blend of Indian and European culture.
goa.audio_guide_text: Wander through Fontainhas, where each façade tells a story of colonial artistry. The São Tomé Chapel, tucked in an alley, offers a quiet glimpse of Goan spirituality.

goa.name: Naval Aviation Museum
goa.description:
Naval Aviation Museum may refer to:

National Naval Aviation Museum in Florida, USA
Canada Aviation and Space Museum in Ottawa, Canada
Naval Aviation Museum (India) in Vasco da Gama, India
Naval Aviation Museum (Argentina) in Buenos Aires, Argentina
goa.address: Naval Aviation Museum, Bogmalo Road, Ranghavi Estate, Bogmalo, Vasco, Mormugao, South Goa, Goa, 403802, India
goa.audio_guide_text: The Naval Aviation Museum chronicles India's maritime skyward journey, from vintage prop planes to modern jets. Outdoor aircraft stand as silent sentinels of naval heritage.

goa.name: Anjuna Beach
goa.description: A legendary stretch of golden sand famous for its vibrant flea market, trance parties and dramatic cliffs. The beach has been a hub for backpackers and surf enthusiasts since the 1960s.
goa.address: Anjuna Beach, Anjuna, Bardez, North Goa, Goa, India
goa.audio_guide_text: Anjuna Beach offers a lively mix of sun, surf, and colorful stalls. The rhythmic crash of waves sets the backdrop for Goa’s famous bohemian vibe.

goa.name: Mapusa Market
goa.description: A bustling weekly market in North Goa where locals sell fresh produce, spices, handicrafts and Goan souvenirs. It provides an authentic glimpse of everyday Goan life and commerce.
goa.address: Mapusa Municipal Market, Cafe Line, Tali Wada, Ansabhat, Mapusa, Bardez, North Goa, Goa, 403507, India
goa.audio_guide_text: Mapusa Market bursts with colors, aromas and the chatter of vendors. Here you can find everything from coconut sweets to intricate brassware.

rishikesh.name: Triveni Ghat
rishikesh.description:
The Triveni Ghat is a ghat situated in Rishikesh, Uttarakhand. It is the biggest and most famous ghat in Rishikesh, located at the banks of the Ganges. 
Devotees visit the ghat to take ritual baths, believing it cleanses them of their sins. It is als
rishikesh.address: Triveni ghat, Puppy Path, Maya Kund, Rishikesh, Dehradun, Uttarakhand, 249201, India
rishikesh.audio_guide_text: Welcome to Triveni Ghat, the holy confluence where three sacred rivers meet. As the sun rises, witness the vibrant aarti that illuminates the banks with devotion.

rishikesh.name: Lakshman Jhula
rishikesh.description: Lakshman Jhula is a suspension bridge across the river Ganges. This is a very famous and older bridge on river ganga and has been closed from 2020. Lakshman Jhula was built in the time of the East India Company.
rishikesh.audio_guide_text: Cross Lakshman Jhula, the iconic iron bridge that links the two banks of the Ganges. Feel the gentle sway as you soak in the misty Himalayan backdrop.

rishikesh.name: Ram Jhula
rishikesh.description: Ram Jhula  (Hindi: राम झूला) is an iron suspension bridge across the river Ganges, located 3 kilometres (1.9 mi) north-east from the center of the city of  Rishikesh in the Indian state of Uttarakhand. The bridge connects the Sivananda Nagar area of
rishikesh.address: Ganga View Cafe Rishikesh, Ram Jhula, Swargashram, Yamkeshwar, Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand, 249137, India
rishikesh.audio_guide_text: Step onto Ram Jhula, the grand bridge that spans the Ganges, linking spiritual neighborhoods. From here, the river's sparkle and the hills' silhouettes create a perfect photo moment.

rishikesh.name: Parmarth Niketan Ashram
rishikesh.description: Parmarth Niketan is one of the largest ashrams on the banks of the Ganges, offering yoga, meditation, and daily Ganga aarti. Founded in 1945, it attracts seekers from around the world.
rishikesh.audio_guide_text: Welcome to Parmarth Niketan, a serene sanctuary where yoga and spirituality converge. Join the evening aarti to feel the collective devotion along the holy river.

rishikesh.name: The Beatles Ashram (Chaurasi Kutia)
rishikesh.description: The Beatles Ashram, once a meditation centre for the Fab Four in 1968, now houses graffiti‑covered ruins and art installations. It offers a glimpse into the band's spiritual quest in the Himalayas.
rishikesh.audio_guide_text: Explore the Beatles Ashram, where music legends once meditated amid forested hills. The vibrant murals and quiet ruins tell a story of artistic and spiritual exploration.

rishikesh.name: Swargashram Area / Kali Kamliwala Kshetra
rishikesh.description: Swargashram, also known as Kali Kamliwala Kshetra, is a tranquil stretch of the Ganges lined with temples and ashrams. It is a favored spot for sunrise prayers and meditation.
rishikesh.address: Swargashram Area / Kali Kamliwala Kshetra, rishikesh
rishikesh.audio_guide_text: Stroll through Swargashram, the heavenly bank where devotees greet the dawn. The gentle chants and river breeze create a peaceful start to the day.

rishikesh.name: Janki Setu (Janki Bridge)
rishikesh.description: Janki Setu is a modest footbridge named after the mythic mother of Lord Rama, offering a quiet crossing over the Ganges. It provides a lesser‑known perspective of the river’s flow.
rishikesh.audio_guide_text: Cross Janki Setu, the gentle footbridge that whispers tales of ancient epics. From here, watch the river glide beneath, framed by lush hills.

rishikesh.name: Patna Waterfall
rishikesh.description: Patna Waterfall is a seasonal cascade nestled in the forested outskirts of Rishikesh, reachable via a short trek. It offers a refreshing dip and a cool retreat from the city heat.
rishikesh.audio_guide_text: Venture to Patna Waterfall, where crystal water tumbles over rocky cliffs. The misty spray and surrounding greenery make it a perfect nature escape.

amritsar.name: Golden Temple
amritsar.description: The Golden Temple is a gurdwara located in Amritsar, Punjab, India. It is the pre-eminent spiritual site of Sikhism and its holiest site. The gurdwara complex is a collection of buildings around the sanctum sanctorum and the sarovar (holy pool), know
amritsar.address: Shri Harmandir Sahib, Golden Temple Road, Hussainpura, Amritsar, Amritsar I Tahsil, Amritsar, Punjab, 143001, India
amritsar.audio_guide_text: Welcome to the Golden Temple, the spiritual heart of Amritsar, where the shimmering dome reflects in the holy pool. Observe the continuous flow of devotion as visitors partake in the free community kitchen, Langar.

amritsar.name: Jallianwala Bagh
amritsar.description: Jallianwala Bagh (IPA: [dʒəlɪjãːʋaːlaː baːɣ, baːɡ]) is a historic garden and memorial of national importance close to the Golden Temple complex in Amritsar, Punjab, India, preserved in the memory of those wounded and killed in the Jallianwala Bagh Ma
amritsar.address: Jallianwala Bagh, Hussainpura, Amritsar, Amritsar I Tahsil, Amritsar, Punjab, 143001, India
amritsar.audio_guide_text: Step into Jallianwala Bagh, a tranquil garden that bears the scars of a tragic chapter in Indian history. The well and the bullet‑riddled walls tell the story of the 1919 massacre.

amritsar.name: Wagah Border
amritsar.description: The Wagah Border ceremony marks the daily lowering of the flags between India and Pakistan and is famed for its dramatic military display. Visitors gather to witness the synchronized marching and patriotic chants of both nations' border forces.
amritsar.address: Bus/Rickshaw to Pakistan Border (aka Attari aka Wagah), Golden Temple Road, Hussainpura, Amritsar, Amritsar I Tahsil, Amritsar, Punjab, 143001, India
amritsar.audio_guide_text: At Wagah Border, experience the electrifying Beating Retreat ceremony where soldiers perform a high‑energy parade. The rhythmic chants and flag‑lowering symbolize the complex relationship between India and Pakistan.

amritsar.name: Partition Museum
amritsar.description: The Partition Museum is a public museum located in the town hall of Amritsar, Punjab, India. The museum aims to become the central repository of stories, materials, and documents related to the post-partition riots that followed the division of Briti
amritsar.address: Partition Museum, Mahan Singh Gate Road, Hussainpura, Amritsar, Amritsar I Tahsil, Amritsar, Punjab, 143006, India
amritsar.audio_guide_text: The Partition Museum offers a moving glimpse into the 1947 upheaval that reshaped the subcontinent. Personal testimonies and artifacts bring the human cost of Partition to life.

amritsar.name: Durgiana Temple
amritsar.description: Durgiana Temple or Shri Durgiana Mandir is a Hindu temple situated in the city of Amritsar in Punjab, India. Though a Hindu temple, its architecture is similar to the Sikh Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple). The temple derives its name from the Goddess
amritsar.address: Shri Durgiana Mandir, Swami Tulsi Das Marg, Hussainpura, Amritsar, Amritsar I Tahsil, Amritsar, Punjab, 143001, India
amritsar.audio_guide_text: Durgiana Temple stands as a stunning replica of the Golden Temple, honoring Hindu gods Lakshmi and Vishnu. Its golden dome and serene pond attract devotees seeking blessings.

amritsar.name: Gobindgarh Fort
amritsar.description: Gobindgarh Fort is a historic military fort located in the center of the city of Amritsar in the Indian state of Punjab. The Fort was until recently under the Indian Army, but was opened to the public on 10 February 2017. Today the fort is being deve
amritsar.address: ਗੋਬਿੰਦਗੜ ਕਿਲ੍ਹਾ, Swami Tulsi Das Marg, Hussainpura, Amritsar, Amritsar I Tahsil, Amritsar, Punjab, 143001, India
amritsar.audio_guide_text: Explore Gobindgarh Fort, a historic stronghold that once guarded the city and now celebrates Punjabi culture. Inside, museums and live folk performances bring the past to life.

amritsar.name: Akal Takht
amritsar.description: The Akal Takht (Punjabi: ਅਕਾਲ ਤਖ਼ਤ ਸਾਹਿਬ; lit. 'Throne of the Timeless'), also spelt as Akal Takhat and historically known as Akal Bunga, is the most prominent of the five takhts (seats of authority) of the Sikhs. Located within the Darbar Sahib (Gol
amritsar.address: Sri Akal Takht Sahib, Golden Temple Road, Hussainpura, Amritsar, Amritsar I Tahsil, Amritsar, Punjab, 143001, India
amritsar.audio_guide_text: Akal Takht, the throne of justice, represents Sikh sovereignty and governance. Its golden dome overlooks the holy pool, reminding visitors of the faith’s rich history.

tokyo.name: Senso-ji Temple
tokyo.description: Founded in 645 AD, Senso-ji is Tokyo's oldest Buddhist temple and a symbol of Asakusa's historic charm. Its iconic Kaminarimon gate and bustling Nakamise‑dori street attract millions of visitors each year.
tokyo.address: Храм Сенсодзи 金龍山 浅草寺, 1, 浅草二丁目, 浅草, 台東区, 東京都, 111-0032, 日本
tokyo.audio_guide_text: Welcome to Senso-ji, Tokyo's ancient heart where the thunder gate greets you with a towering red lantern. Step inside to discover centuries‑old worship traditions and the lively market that has thrived for generations.

tokyo.name: Tokyo Tower
tokyo.description: Tokyo Tower (東京タワー, Tōkyō Tawā; pronounced [toːkʲoː taꜜɰᵝaː] ), also known by its official name Japan Radio Tower (日本電波塔, Nippon denpatō) is a communications and observation tower in the district of Shiba-koen in Minato, Tokyo, Japan, completed in 19
tokyo.address: 東京タワー, 東京タワー通り, 芝公園四丁目, 芝公園, 港区, 東京都, 106-0041, 日本
tokyo.audio_guide_text: Rising 333 meters above the city, Tokyo Tower blends retro charm with modern vistas. From the observation decks you can spot the Skytree, the Imperial Palace, and the glittering lights of Shibuya.

tokyo.name: Tokyo Skytree
tokyo.description: Tokyo Skytree (東京スカイツリー, Tōkyō Sukaitsurī; [toːkʲoː sɯ̥kaitsɯriː] ), a.k.a Tokyo Sky Tree, is a broadcasting and observation tower, located in Sumida, Tokyo, Japan. It has been the tallest tower in Japan since opening in 2012, and reached its full he
tokyo.address: 東京スカイツリー, 2, 押上一丁目, 押上, 墨田区, 東京都, 131-0045, 日本
tokyo.audio_guide_text: Welcome to Tokyo Skytree, a marvel of engineering that pierces the sky at 634 meters. Ascend to the observation decks for a sweeping panorama that stretches from the bustling cityscape to distant mountain peaks.

tokyo.name: Meiji Shrine
tokyo.description: Meiji Shrine (明治神宮, Meiji Jingū) is a Shinto shrine in Shibuya, Tokyo, that is dedicated to the deified spirits of Emperor Meiji and his wife, Empress Shōken. The shrine does not contain the emperor's grave, which is located at Fushimi-momoyama, sout
tokyo.address: 明治神宮, 1, 代々木神園町, 渋谷区, 東京都, 151-8557, 日本
tokyo.audio_guide_text: Meiji Shrine stands as a peaceful oasis amid Tokyo's hustle, honoring the emperor who led Japan into the modern era. Walk through the towering torii gates and feel the serenity of the surrounding cedar grove.

tokyo.name: Imperial Palace East Gardens
tokyo.description: The East Gardens occupy the former site of Edo Castle's innermost enclosure and showcase historic stone walls, moats, and seasonal flora. They offer a glimpse into Japan's feudal past within the heart of the capital.
tokyo.address: 皇居東御苑, 千代田区, 東京都, 102-0000, 日本
tokyo.audio_guide_text: Step into the Imperial Palace East Gardens, where centuries‑old stone walls frame meticulously landscaped grounds. This historic site once protected the shogun's castle and now welcomes visitors to explore its quiet beauty.

tokyo.name: Shibuya Crossing
tokyo.description: Shibuya Scramble Crossing (渋谷スクランブル交差点, Shibuya sukuranburu kōsaten), commonly known as Shibuya Crossing, is a scramble crossing in Shibuya, Tokyo, Japan. It is located near Shibuya Station in Shibuya, a major commercial and entertainment district in
tokyo.address: 渋谷駅前交差点, 神宮通り, 道玄坂二丁目, 道玄坂, 渋谷区, 東京都, 150-0043, 日本
tokyo.audio_guide_text: Welcome to Shibuya Crossing, where hundreds surge across the intersection with each traffic light. Feel the pulse of Tokyo as the surrounding screens flash and the city moves around you.

tokyo.name: Tsukiji Outer Market
tokyo.description: After the inner wholesale market moved, the Outer Market remains a bustling hub for fresh seafood, street food, and kitchenware. It offers a sensory taste of Tokyo's culinary heritage.
tokyo.address: 築地場外市場, 新大橋通り, 築地二丁目, 築地, 中央区, 東京都, 104-0045, 日本
tokyo.audio_guide_text: Tsukiji Outer Market awakens before sunrise, filling the air with the scent of grilled fish and seaweed. Wander the stalls to sample sushi, pick up unique kitchen tools, and experience Tokyo's food culture.

rome.name: Colosseum
rome.description: The Colosseum ( KOL-ə-SEE-əm; Italian: Colosseo [kolosˈsɛːo]) is an elliptical amphitheatre in the centre of the city of Rome, Italy, just east of the Roman Forum. It is the largest ancient amphitheatre ever built, and is the largest standing amphith
rome.address: Colosseo, Celio, Municipio Roma I, Roma, Roma Capitale, Lazio, 00184, Italia
rome.audio_guide_text: The Colosseum, once the grand arena of gladiators, could hold up to 80,000 spectators in ancient Rome. Today it stands as a testament to Roman engineering and the enduring allure of the empire.

rome.name: Vatican Museums
rome.description: The Vatican Museums (Italian: Musei Vaticani; Latin: Musea Vaticana) are the public museums of the Vatican City. They display works from the immense collection amassed by the Catholic Church and the papacy throughout the centuries, including several
rome.audio_guide_text: Inside the Vatican Museums lies centuries of artistic mastery, from classical sculptures to Raphael's rooms. The highlight, Michelangelo's Sistine Chapel ceiling, draws millions to marvel at its divine frescoes.

rome.name: Pantheon
rome.description:
Pantheon may refer to:

Pantheon (religion), a set of gods belonging to a particular religion or tradition, and a temple or sacred building
Pantheon, Rome, Italy, a Catholic church and former Roman temple
Pantheon may also refer to:
rome.address: Pantheon, Piazza della Rotonda, Colonna, Municipio Roma I, Roma, Roma Capitale, Lazio, 00186, Italia
rome.audio_guide_text: The Pantheon, with its perfect dome and oculus, has stood for nearly two millennia as a marvel of ancient engineering. Originally a temple to all gods, it now serves as a church and a symbol of Rome's layered history.

rome.name: Roman Forum
rome.description: The Roman Forum (Italian: Foro Romano), also known by its Latin name Forum Romanum, is a rectangular forum (plaza) surrounded by the ruins of several important ancient government buildings at the centre of the city of Rome. Citizens of the ancient ci
rome.address: Forum Romanum, Via dei Fori Imperiali, Campitelli, Municipio Roma I, Roma, Roma Capitale, Lazio, 00184, Italia
rome.audio_guide_text: The Roman Forum was the bustling center of political, religious, and commercial activity in antiquity. Walking among its marble columns, you can imagine the speeches and triumphs that shaped the empire.

cairo.name: Giza Pyramids Complex
cairo.description: The iconic pyramids of Khufu, Khafre, and Menkaure stand as the last surviving wonder of the ancient world. They showcase the engineering brilliance of Old Kingdom Egypt and attract millions of visitors each year.
cairo.audio_guide_text: Welcome to the Giza Plateau, where the Great Pyramid of Khufu towers over the desert as a testament to ancient ambition. Look around and imagine the thousands of workers who moved these massive stones over 4,500 years ago.

cairo.name: Egyptian Museum, Cairo
cairo.description: Home to the world’s largest collection of Pharaonic antiquities, including the treasures of Tutankhamun. The museum chronicles over 5,000 years of Egyptian civilization.
cairo.address: المتحف المصري, شارع مريت باشا, الإسماعيلية, باب اللوق, القاهرة, 11556, مصر
cairo.audio_guide_text: Step inside the Egyptian Museum and be greeted by the glittering gold mask of Tutankhamun, a symbol of the boy king’s enduring legacy. Each hall tells a story of dynasties, gods, and the daily life of ancient Egypt.

cairo.name: Khan El‑Khalili Bazaar
cairo.description: Founded in 1382, this bustling market is the heart of Islamic Cairo, offering spices, jewelry, textiles, and traditional crafts. Its labyrinthine alleys echo centuries of trade and culture.
cairo.address: Bazaar, سكه البادستان, خان الخليلى, القاهرة الإسلامية, القاهرة, 11261, مصر
cairo.audio_guide_text: Wander through Khan El‑Khalili, where the scent of incense mingles with the chatter of merchants. Every stall holds a piece of Cairo’s vibrant heritage, from hand‑woven carpets to aromatic herbs.

cairo.name: Cairo Citadel (Saladin’s Fortress)
cairo.description: Built by Saladin in the 12th century, the citadel served as Egypt’s seat of power and a defensive stronghold. It offers panoramic views of the city and houses several historic mosques.
cairo.audio_guide_text: Perched atop the Mokattam hills, the Citadel stands as a monument to medieval military architecture. Explore its massive walls and imagine the battles that once echoed across its courtyards.

cairo.name: Muhammad Ali Mosque (Alabaster Mosque)
cairo.description: Often called the Alabaster Mosque, this Ottoman‑style masterpiece crowns the Citadel’s highest point. Constructed in the 19th century, it reflects Egypt’s modernizing era under Muhammad Ali Pasha.
cairo.audio_guide_text: Look up at the soaring domes of the Muhammad Ali Mosque, a symbol of Egypt’s renaissance. Its white marble façade glistens in the sun, offering a serene contrast to the bustling city below.

cairo.name: Saqqara Necropolis
cairo.description: Saqqara is the vast burial ground of the ancient capital, featuring the Step Pyramid of Djoser, the world’s first stone pyramid. The site spans millennia of funerary art and architecture.
cairo.audio_guide_text: Enter Saqqara, where the Step Pyramid rises like a staircase to the heavens, marking a revolutionary shift in tomb design. Walk among centuries‑old reliefs that tell the stories of forgotten pharaohs.

cairo.name: Al‑Azhar Mosque
cairo.description: Founded in 970 AD, Al‑Azhar is one of the world’s oldest universities and a cornerstone of Sunni Islamic scholarship. Its sprawling complex blends prayer halls, libraries, and historic minarets.
cairo.address: الجامع الأزهر, حارة السوق, الأزهر, الغورية, القاهرة, 11675, مصر
cairo.audio_guide_text: Step into Al‑Azhar Mosque, where scholars have studied for over a thousand years. The intricate arabesques and echoing calls to prayer create a timeless atmosphere.

varanasi.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
varanasi.description: Kashi Vishwanath Temple is a Hindu temple dedicated to Shiva. It is located in Vishwanath Gali, in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India. The temple is a Hindu pilgrimage site and is one of the twelve Jyotirlinga shrines. The presiding deity is known by the
varanasi.address: Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Tripura Bhairwi, Banaras Ghats, Varanasi, Sadar, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, 221001, India
varanasi.audio_guide_text: Welcome to Kashi Vishwanath, the ancient shrine of Lord Shiva, where the sacred black stone lingam has been worshipped for centuries. Observe the gleaming gold spire that crowns the temple, a beacon for devotees arriving from across India.

varanasi.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat
varanasi.description: Dashashwamedh Ghat is a main ghat in Varanasi located on the Ganges River in Uttar Pradesh, India. It is located close to Vishwanath Temple. There are two Hindu legends associated with the ghat: according to one, Brahma created it to welcome Shiva, a
varanasi.audio_guide_text: Standing on Dashashwamedh Ghat, you feel the pulse of Varanasi as lamps flicker and chants rise over the Ganges. The nightly aarti transforms the riverbank into a sea of light and devotion.

varanasi.name: Manikarnika Ghat
varanasi.description: Manikarnika Ghat (Hindi: मणिकर्णिका घाट) is a cremation ground on the banks of River Ganges, in the city of Varanasi in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. In Hinduism it is believed that a human's soul attains moksha, and hence breaks the cycle of re
varanasi.address: Manikarnika Ghat, exit(kashi temple), Banaras Ghats, Varanasi, Sadar, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, 221001, India
varanasi.audio_guide_text: Manikarnika Ghat is where life meets eternity, as families perform last rites beside the holy Ganges. The solemn rituals here embody the Hindu belief in rebirth and moksha.

varanasi.name: Sarnath Museum
varanasi.description: Sarnath Museum, or Archaeological Museum Sarnath, is the oldest site museum of the Archaeological Survey of India. It houses the findings and excavations at the archaeological site of Sarnath, by the Archaeological Survey of India. Sarnath is located
varanasi.address: सारनाथ पुरातत्व संग्रहालय, Dharmapala Road, Sarnath, Sadar, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, 221007, India
varanasi.audio_guide_text: Inside Sarnath Museum, marvel at the exquisite Ashoka Lion Capital that once crowned an imperial pillar. Each gallery narrates the spread of Buddhism from its birthplace to far‑flung lands.

varanasi.name: Ramnagar Fort
varanasi.description: The Ramnagar Fort is a fortification in Ramnagar, Varanasi, India.  It is located near the Ganges on its eastern bank, opposite to the Tulsi Ghat. The sandstone structure was built in 1750 by Kashi Naresh Maharaja Balwant Singh. The current king and
varanasi.address: रामनगर किला, Ramnagar Road, Banaras Ghats, Ashram, Milkipur, Sadar, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, 221008, India
varanasi.audio_guide_text: Ramnagar Fort stands as a testament to the regal past of Varanasi, with its grand gates and historic armory. Explore the museum inside to see royal costumes, vintage cars, and ancient weaponry.

varanasi.name: Bharat Mata Temple
varanasi.description: Bharat Mata Temple is dedicated to Mother India and features a massive marble map of undivided India carved to scale. Inaugurated by Mahatma Gandhi in 1936, it symbolizes national unity rather than religious worship.
varanasi.audio_guide_text: The Bharat Mata Temple honors the nation with a marble map that details every mountain, plain, and ocean. Its unique design makes it a pilgrimage for patriots and history lovers alike.

varanasi.name: Banaras Hindu University (BHU)
varanasi.description: Founded in 1916, Banaras Hindu University is one of India's largest residential universities and a center of learning and culture. Its sprawling campus includes the historic Shri Vishwanath Temple and a grand library.
varanasi.address: Banaras Hindu University, Electronics Department  Road, Varanasi, Sadar, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, 221005, India
varanasi.audio_guide_text: BHU blends academic excellence with spiritual heritage, featuring the elegant Shri Vishwanath Temple within its grounds. Stroll through its leafy avenues to feel the pulse of scholarly tradition.

varanasi.name: Assi Ghat
varanasi.description: Assi Ghat is the southernmost ghat in Varanasi, India.  To most visitors to Varanasi, it is known for being a place where long-term foreign students, researchers, and tourists live. The ghat hosts Subah-e-Banaras, a cultural and spiritual event, in t
varanasi.address: Assi Ghat, Assi Ghat Road, Banaras Ghats, Varanasi, Sadar, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, 222005, India
varanasi.audio_guide_text: At Assi Ghat, the day begins with gentle chants and yogis greeting the first light on the Ganges. The ghat’s lively atmosphere offers a glimpse into everyday Varanasi life.

reykjavik.name: Hallgrímskirkja
reykjavik.description: Hallgrímskirkja (Icelandic pronunciation: [ˈhatl̥ˌkrimsˌcʰɪr̥ca], Church of Hallgrímur) is a Protestant Lutheran (Church of Iceland) parish church in Reykjavík, Iceland. At 74.5 metres (244 ft) tall, it is the largest church in Iceland and second tal
reykjavik.address: Hallgrímskirkja, 1, Hallgrímstorg, Tungan, Miðborg, Reykjavíkurborg, Höfuðborgarsvæðið, 101, Ísland
reykjavik.audio_guide_text: Welcome to Hallgrímskirkja, the towering landmark that dominates Reykjavik's skyline. Ascend the observation deck for sweeping vistas of the city, harbor, and surrounding mountains.

reykjavik.name: Harpa Concert Hall
reykjavik.description: Harpa is a striking glass concert hall on the Reykjavik waterfront, opened in 2011 and renowned for its innovative geometry. It hosts concerts, conferences, and cultural events, embodying Iceland's contemporary spirit.
reykjavik.audio_guide_text: Harpa's crystalline façade reflects the sea and sky, creating a dazzling play of light. Inside, world‑class acoustics make it a premier venue for music and the arts.

reykjavik.name: Sun Voyager (Sólfar)
reykjavik.description: The Sun Voyager is a striking stainless‑steel sculpture by Jón Gunnar Árnason, unveiled in 1990 as a dreamboat symbolizing exploration. It sits on Reykjavik's waterfront, offering a perfect photo backdrop at sunrise and sunset.
reykjavik.address: Sólfar, Mánaleið, Austurbær, Miðborg, Reykjavíkurborg, Höfuðborgarsvæðið, 101, Ísland
reykjavik.audio_guide_text: Standing against the sea, the Sun Voyager captures the spirit of Viking voyages and modern optimism. Its sleek lines invite visitors to imagine journeys beyond the horizon.

reykjavik.name: Perlan
reykjavik.description: Perlan (Icelandic pronunciation: [ˈpʰɛrtlan]; English: The Pearl) is a natural history museum in Reykjavík, Iceland. It is situated on the top of Öskjuhlíð hill. It was initially only a cluster of hot water tanks, but on June 21, 1991, the building w
reykjavik.address: Perlan, 1, Varmahlíð, Hlíðar, Reykjavíkurborg, Höfuðborgarsvæðið, 105, Ísland
reykjavik.audio_guide_text: Explore Perlan's interactive exhibits that reveal Iceland's volcanic and glacial forces. From the observation deck, you can spot the city spread out beneath you.

reykjavik.name: National Museum of Iceland
reykjavik.description: The National Museum of Iceland (Icelandic: Þjóðminjasafn Íslands, [ˈθjouðˌmɪnjaˌsapn ˈistlan(t)s]) is a museum in Reykjavík, Iceland. It was established on 24 February 1863, with Jón Árnason the first curator of the Icelandic collection, previously k
reykjavik.address: Þjóðminjasafn Íslands, 41, Suðurgata, Háskóli, Miðborg, Reykjavíkurborg, Höfuðborgarsvæðið, 102, Ísland
reykjavik.audio_guide_text: Step into Iceland's past, from the first settlers to modern independence. The museum's treasures tell stories of resilience and creativity across centuries.

reykjavik.name: Reykjavik Art Museum – Kjarvalsstaðir
reykjavik.description: Kjarvalsstaðir houses the works of Icelandic masters like Jóhannes Kjarval and Ásgrímur Jónsson, set within a tranquil garden. It highlights 20th‑century Icelandic painting and sculpture.
reykjavik.audio_guide_text: Wander through galleries that celebrate Iceland's artistic vision, from bold landscapes to abstract forms. The surrounding garden offers a peaceful pause between exhibits.

reykjavik.name: Old Harbour (Gamla höfn)
reykjavik.description: Reykjavik's Old Harbour is a lively waterfront area with fishing boats, seafood restaurants, and whale‑watching tours. It reflects the city's maritime heritage and modern leisure culture.
reykjavik.audio_guide_text: Stroll along the bustling piers where traditional fishing meets contemporary tourism. The harbor offers fresh seafood, boutique shops, and chances to spot marine life.

reykjavik.name: Laugavegur Shopping Street
reykjavik.description: Laugavegur is Reykjavik's main shopping boulevard, lined with boutiques, design stores, cafés, and street art. It captures the city's vibrant creative scene and offers local Icelandic products.
reykjavik.audio_guide_text: Explore Laugavegur's eclectic mix of fashion, art, and gastronomy, where every storefront tells a story. It's the perfect place to find Icelandic design souvenirs.

kyoto.name: Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion)
kyoto.description: Kinkaku-ji, originally a retirement villa of shogun Ashikaga Yoshimitsu, was converted into a Zen temple in the 14th century. Its top two floors are completely covered in gold leaf, reflecting brilliantly on the surrounding pond.
kyoto.audio_guide_text: Welcome to Kinkaku-ji, the Golden Pavilion, a masterpiece of Muromachi period architecture shimmering over its mirror‑like pond. As you walk around, imagine the shogun's vision of a serene retreat turned sacred Zen temple.

kyoto.name: Fushimi Inari Taisha
kyoto.description: Fushimi Inari is the head shrine of Japan's Inari worship, famous for its thousands of vermilion torii gates forming endless pathways. The shrine dates back to 711 AD and honors the deity of rice, fertility, and industry.
kyoto.address: 伏見稲荷大社, 伏見区, 京都市, 京都府, 612-0882, 日本
kyoto.audio_guide_text: Step onto the iconic torii tunnel of Fushimi Inari, a pilgrimage route that winds up Mount Inari. Each gate was donated by individuals and businesses seeking blessings from the god of prosperity.

kyoto.name: Kiyomizu-dera Temple
kyoto.description: Founded in 778 AD, Kiyomizu-dera is a UNESCO World Heritage site renowned for its wooden stage that juts out over the hillside. The temple offers panoramic views of Kyoto and houses the sacred Jishu Shrine of love.
kyoto.address: 清水寺, 東大路通, 梅林町, 辰巳町, 東山区, 京都市, 京都府, 605-0864, 日本
kyoto.audio_guide_text: Welcome to Kiyomizu-dera, where the legendary wooden platform seems to float above the city. Legend says drinking from its Otowa Waterfall grants longevity, success, and love.

kyoto.name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
kyoto.description: The Arashiyama Bamboo Grove is a serene forest of towering bamboo stalks that sway gently with the wind. It has become an iconic symbol of Kyoto's natural beauty and a favorite photography spot.
kyoto.address: 嵐山竹林, 宇多野嵐山山田線, 嵯峨天龍寺立石町, 右京区, 京都市, 京都府, 616-0000, 日本
kyoto.audio_guide_text: Walk through the whispering bamboo forest of Arashiyama, where sunlight filters through emerald canes. The rhythmic rustle creates a meditative soundtrack for your stroll.

kyoto.name: Gion Corner
kyoto.description: Gion Corner presents daily performances of traditional Japanese arts, including tea ceremony, ikebana, and maiko dances, within the historic Gion district. It offers visitors a compact showcase of Kyoto's cultural heritage.
kyoto.address: ギオンコーナー, 花見小路, 祇園町南側, 辰巳町, 東山区, 京都市, 京都府, 605-0074, 日本
kyoto.audio_guide_text: Experience the elegance of Gion Corner, where maiko and geisha perform timeless arts for modern audiences. Each demonstration reveals a piece of Kyoto's refined cultural tapestry.

kyoto.name: Nishiki Market
kyoto.description: Nishiki Market (錦市場, Nishiki Ichiba; literally "brocade market") is a marketplace in downtown Kyoto, located on the east end of Nishikikōji Street, one block north and parallel to Shijō Street (四条通, Shijō-dōri) and west of Teramachi Street (寺町通, Tera
kyoto.address: 錦市場, 錦小路通, 東魚屋町, 中京区, 京都市, 京都府, 600-8006, 日本
kyoto.audio_guide_text: Explore Nishiki Market, where stalls brim with fresh seafood, pickles, and traditional sweets. Taste the flavors that have fed Kyoto's residents for centuries.

kyoto.name: Nijo Castle
kyoto.description: Built in 1603 as the residence of Tokugawa Ieyasu's grandson, Nijo Castle showcases feudal architecture and the famous "nightingale floors" that chirp underfoot. It symbolizes the power of the early Edo shogunate.
kyoto.address: 二条城, 押小路通, 門前町, 中京区, 京都市, 京都府, 604-8375, 日本
kyoto.audio_guide_text: Step inside Nijo Castle, where the shogun once governed and the squeaky nightingale floors warned of intruders. The palace interiors display exquisite wall paintings and gold leaf accents.

kyoto.name: Kyoto Imperial Palace
kyoto.description: The Kyōto Imperial Palace (京都御所, Kyōto-gosho), also known as Dairi (内裏) or Kinri (禁裏), is the former palace of the Emperor of Japan from 1331 to 1869 located in Kamigyō-ku, Kyoto, Japan. Since the Meiji Restoration in 1869, the Emperors have resided
kyoto.address: 京都御所, 3, 京都御苑, 上京区, 京都市, 京都府, 602-0881, 日本
kyoto.audio_guide_text: Wander the serene grounds of the Kyoto Imperial Palace, where emperors once held court. The palace's graceful halls and manicured gardens reflect centuries of refined court culture.

zermatt.name: Matterhorn
zermatt.description: The Matterhorn is a mountain of the Alps, straddling the main watershed and border between Switzerland and Italy. It is a large, near-symmetric pyramidal peak in the extended Monte Rosa area of the Pennine Alps, whose summit is 4,478 metres (14,692 f
zermatt.address: Matterhorn, Zermatt, Visp, Oberwallis, Valais/Wallis, 3920, Schweiz/Suisse/Svizzera/Svizra
zermatt.audio_guide_text: Look up and you’ll see the unmistakable silhouette of the Matterhorn, a mountain that has inspired climbers for more than a century. Its sheer faces and dramatic ridges make it one of the world’s most photographed peaks.

zermatt.name: Matterhorn Glacier Paradise (Klein Matterhorn)
zermatt.description: At 3,883 m, Matterhorn Glacier Paradise is Europe’s highest cable‑car station, offering panoramic views of the surrounding 4,000‑metre peaks. It serves as a gateway to year‑round snow activities and the world’s highest viewing platform.
zermatt.address: Trockener Steg - Klein Matterhorn Glacier Ride, Matterhorn Glacier Paradise, Zermatt, Visp, Oberwallis, Valais/Wallis, 3920, Schweiz/Suisse/Svizzera/Svizra
zermatt.audio_guide_text: Ride the cable car up to the Klein Matterhorn and step onto the highest observation deck in Europe. From here you can see the endless Alpine horizon and the iconic Matterhorn looming nearby.

zermatt.name: Gornergrat Railway
zermatt.description: The Gornergrat Railway (German: Gornergrat Bahn; GGB) is a  mountain rack railway, located in the Swiss canton of Valais. It links the  resort village of Zermatt, situated at 1,604 m (5,262 ft) above mean sea level, to the summit of the Gornergrat. T
zermatt.audio_guide_text: Board the vintage cogwheel train and ascend through alpine forests to the Gornergrat plateau. At the top, the panorama of snow‑capped peaks stretches as far as the eye can see.

zermatt.name: Sunnegga Paradise
zermatt.description: Sunnegga is a sunny family‑friendly area reached by a funicular, offering gentle slopes, a lake, and unrivalled views of the Matterhorn. It’s a popular spot for picnics and beginner skiing.
zermatt.address: Sunnegga Paradise, Sunnegga Trail Zermatt, Tufteren, Zermatt, Visp, Oberwallis, Valais/Wallis, 3920, Schweiz/Suisse/Svizzera/Svizra
zermatt.audio_guide_text: Take the funicular up to Sunnegga, where sunshine, a crystal‑clear lake, and the Matterhorn’s reflection await. It’s the perfect place to relax after a morning on the slopes.

zermatt.name: Matterhorn Museum – Zermatlantis
zermatt.description: Zermatlantis tells the story of Zermatt’s evolution from a mining village to a world‑renowned resort, with exhibits on mountaineering, local culture, and the famous Matterhorn. The museum blends historic artifacts with interactive displays.
zermatt.audio_guide_text: Step inside Zermatlantis to discover Zermatt’s rich heritage, from its copper‑mining roots to the golden age of Alpine climbing. The museum’s immersive exhibits bring the mountain’s legends to life.

zermatt.name: Church of St. Mauritius
zermatt.description: Built in 1494, St. Mauritius is Zermatt’s oldest parish church, featuring a striking wooden interior and a historic organ. It has served the community for over five centuries.
zermatt.audio_guide_text: Enter the centuries‑old Church of St. Mauritius and admire its simple yet elegant wooden nave. The quiet atmosphere offers a glimpse into Zermatt’s spiritual past.

cusco.name: Machu Picchu
cusco.description: Machu Picchu is a 15th-century Inca citadel located in the Eastern Cordillera of southern  Peru  on a mountain ridge at  2,430 meters (7,970 ft). It is situated in the Machupicchu District of Urubamba Province about 80 kilometers (50 miles) northwest
cusco.address: Ciudadela de Machu Picchu, Circuit 1, San Miguel, Intihuatana, Machupicchu, Urubamba, Cusco, 08680, Perú
cusco.audio_guide_text: Welcome to Machu Picchu, the legendary "Lost City of the Incas" overlooking the Urubamba River. As you walk among its terraces and temples, imagine the empire that once thrived here over 500 years ago.

cusco.name: Sacsayhuamán
cusco.description: Sacsayhuamán ( SACK-sy-wuh-mən; Spanish pronunciation: [saksajwaˈman]) or Saksaywaman (from Quechua Saksay waman pukara, pronounced [ˈsaksaj ˈwaman], lit. 'fortress of the royal falcon or hawk') is a citadel on the northern outskirts of the city of C
cusco.address: Sacsayhuamán, Mollococha, Cuzco, Distrito de Cusco, Cusco, Perú
cusco.audio_guide_text: Here stands Sacsayhuamán, an engineering marvel where stones weigh up to 200 tons yet fit perfectly together. The fortress reflects the Inca's mastery of stonework and their strategic acumen.

cusco.name: Qorikancha (Temple of the Sun)
cusco.description: Qorikancha was the most important temple in the Inca capital, dedicated to the sun god Inti, and later overlaid with a colonial church. Its walls were once covered in gold sheets, showcasing the empire's wealth and devotion.
cusco.audio_guide_text: Step inside Qorikancha, the Inca's golden sanctuary to the sun, now home to the Santo Domingo Church. Observe the blend of Inca stone foundations with Spanish baroque architecture.

cusco.name: Plaza de Armas
cusco.description: Plaza de Armas may refer to:
cusco.address: Plaza de Armas, Hauqaypata, San Cristóbal, Mollococha, Cuzco, Distrito de Cusco, Cusco, 08001, Perú
cusco.audio_guide_text: Welcome to Plaza de Armas, the vibrant core of Cusco where centuries of history converge. Take in the cathedral's façade and the lively street performers that animate the square.

cusco.name: Ollantaytambo Ruins
cusco.description: Ollantaytambo is a well‑preserved Inca town and fortress in the Sacred Valley, known for its massive terraces and ceremonial stone structures. It was a strategic military site and the last stronghold of the Incas before the Spanish conquest.
cusco.address: Ruinas de Pumamarca, Sendero Ollanta-Pumamarca, Pallata, Ollantaytambo, Urubamba, Cusco, 08675, Perú
cusco.audio_guide_text: Explore Ollantaytambo, where the Inca engineered terraces that climb the mountainside like a staircase. The site reveals both religious ceremonies and defensive ingenuity.

cusco.name: Pisac Archaeological Park
cusco.description: Pisac features an extensive Inca complex of terraces, temples, and burial chambers overlooking the Sacred Valley. The site demonstrates the Incas' agricultural mastery and spiritual practices.
cusco.address: Parque Arqueológico Nacional de Pisaq, Pisac, Calca, Cusco, Perú
cusco.audio_guide_text: At Pisac, marvel at the terraced hillsides that once fed the empire and the sacred temples that faced the sunrise. The panoramic valley view adds a dramatic backdrop to the ruins.

queenstown.name: Skyline Queenstown
queenstown.description: Skyline Queenstown offers a scenic gondola ride up Bob's Peak with panoramic views of the town and Lake Wakatipu. It also features the thrilling luge tracks and a restaurant at the summit.
queenstown.address: Skyline Luge Queenstown, Skyline Road, Boydtown, Queenstown, Queenstown-Lakes District, Otago, 9200, New Zealand / Aotearoa
queenstown.audio_guide_text: Welcome to Skyline Queenstown, where the gondola lifts you 400 metres above the town for unrivalled vistas. From the summit you can glide down the luge or simply soak in the breathtaking alpine scenery.

queenstown.name: Lake Wakatipu
queenstown.description: Lake Wakatipu (Māori: Whakatipu Waimāori) is an inland lake (finger lake) in the South Island of New Zealand. It is in the southwest corner of the Otago region, near its boundary with Southland. The name Wakatipu comes from the Māori name of the lake
queenstown.address: Lake Wakatipu, Queenstown-Lakes District, Otago, New Zealand / Aotearoa
queenstown.audio_guide_text: Gaze upon Lake Wakatipu, the shimmering jewel of Queenstown, framed by towering peaks. Whether you stroll the lakeside promenade or take a boat cruise, the lake’s beauty is unforgettable.

queenstown.name: Shotover Jet
queenstown.description: The Shotover Jet whisks visitors through the narrow Shotover River canyons at high speed, delivering an adrenaline‑pumping experience. It has become an iconic Queenstown attraction since the 1970s.
queenstown.address: Shotover Jet, Oxenbridge Tunnel Road, Arthurs Point, Queenstown-Lakes District, Otago, 9306, New Zealand / Aotearoa
queenstown.audio_guide_text: Hold on tight as the Shotover Jet rockets through the dramatic canyon walls, spraying water and excitement. This high‑speed ride showcases the raw power of the Shotover River.

queenstown.name: The Remarkables
queenstown.description: The Remarkables (Māori: Kawarau) are a mountain range and part of the Remarkables Conservation Area that includes Kawarau/The Remarkables and Tāpuae O’Uenuku/Hector Mountains and Te Papapuni/Nevis River valley. Located on the southeastern shore of La
queenstown.address: The Remarkables, Queenstown-Lakes District, Otago, New Zealand / Aotearoa
queenstown.audio_guide_text: Welcome to The Remarkables, where rugged peaks rise dramatically above the valley. Whether on skis or on foot, the alpine scenery here is truly unforgettable.

queenstown.name: Kiwi Birdlife Park
queenstown.description: Kiwi Birdlife Park is a conservation sanctuary dedicated to New Zealand’s native wildlife, including the iconic kiwi bird. It offers close encounters with rare species and educational displays.
queenstown.address: Kiwi Birdlife Park, Brecon Street, Boydtown, Queenstown, Queenstown-Lakes District, Otago, 9200, New Zealand / Aotearoa
queenstown.audio_guide_text: Step into Kiwi Birdlife Park, a haven for New Zealand’s unique fauna. Here you’ll meet the nocturnal kiwi and learn about the country’s dedicated conservation efforts.

queenstown.name: AJ Hackett Bungy Jump
queenstown.description: AJ Hackett pioneered commercial bungee jumping, and its Queenstown site offers a 43‑metre plunge over the Kawarau River. The jump is a bucket‑list experience for thrill‑seekers worldwide.
queenstown.audio_guide_text: Feel the rush as you leap from the AJ Hackett platform, free‑falling over the Kawarau River. This iconic bungee jump is the ultimate test of courage.

queenstown.name: Queenstown Gardens
queenstown.description: The Queenstown Gardens, located next to the town of Queenstown, New Zealand, is a botanical garden which contains a variety of exotic and native trees and plants as well as a large pond and a range of facilities. The facilities in the garden include
queenstown.address: Queenstown Gardens, Boydtown, Queenstown, Queenstown-Lakes District, Otago, New Zealand / Aotearoa
queenstown.audio_guide_text: Wander through Queenstown Gardens, where manicured lawns meet stunning lake views. The park’s serene pathways are perfect for a leisurely stroll or a game of frisbee golf.

queenstown.name: Arrowtown Historic Precinct
queenstown.description: Arrowtown preserves the gold‑rush heritage of the 1860s with restored buildings, museums, and cobblestone streets. The town’s charm reflects its pioneering past and vibrant community.
queenstown.audio_guide_text: Explore Arrowtown’s historic precinct, where gold‑rush era architecture tells stories of early settlers. Stroll the charming streets and discover museums that celebrate this rich legacy.

pune.name: Shaniwar Wada
pune.description: Shaniwar Wada is a historical fortification in the city of Pune, India. Built in 1732, it was the seat of the Peshwas of the Maratha Confederacy until 1818. The fort itself was largely destroyed in 1828 by an unexplained fire, but the surviving struc
pune.address: Shaniwar Wada, Shivaji Road, Kasba Peth, Pune, Pune City Subdistrict, Pune, Maharashtra, 411001, India
pune.audio_guide_text: Welcome to Shaniwar Wada, the historic fort that once housed the Maratha empire's prime ministers. Explore its towering gates and imagine the grandeur of the Peshwa era.

pune.name: Aga Khan Palace
pune.description:
The Aga Khan Palace was built by Sultan Muhammed Shah Aga Khan III in the city of Pune, India. .
The palace was an act of charity by the spiritual leader of the Nizari Ismaili Muslims, who wanted to help the poor in the neighbouring areas of Pune, wh
pune.address: Aga Khan Palace, Nagar Road, Kalyani Nagar, Pune City Subdistrict, Pune, Maharashtra, 411011, India
pune.audio_guide_text: Aga Khan Palace stands as a silent witness to India's fight for independence, where Gandhi was once confined. Wander its elegant corridors and reflect on the legacy of non‑violent resistance.

pune.name: Dagdusheth Halwai Ganpati Temple
pune.description: Founded in 1895 by the Halwai family, this temple houses a richly adorned idol of Lord Ganesha that draws millions of devotees each year. It is famed for its elaborate celebrations during Ganesh Chaturthi.
pune.audio_guide_text: The Dagdusheth Halwai Ganpati Temple is a vibrant hub of devotion, famed for its opulent Ganesha idol. Experience the spiritual energy that fills this beloved sanctuary.

pune.name: Pataleshwar Cave Temple
pune.description: Carved out of a single basalt rock in the 8th century, this rock‑cut temple is dedicated to Lord Shiva. Its ancient pillars and intricate carvings illustrate early Indian rock architecture.
pune.address: Pataleshwar cave temple, Kushabhau Jejurikar Road, Shivajinagar, Pune, Pune City Subdistrict, Pune, Maharashtra, 411001, India
pune.audio_guide_text: Descend into the Pataleshwar Cave Temple, an 8th‑century marvel hewn from solid basalt. Observe the timeless Shiva shrine and its delicate stone carvings.

pune.name: Raja Dinkar Kelkar Museum
pune.description: The Raja Dinkar Kelkar Museum is in Pune, Maharashtra, India. It contains the collection of Dr. Dinkar G. Kelkar (1896–1990), dedicated to the memory of his only son, Raja. The three-storey building houses various sculptures dating back to the 14th c
pune.address: Raja Dinkar Kelkar Museum, Raja Dinkar Kelkar Sangrahalay Path, Shukrawar Peth, Pune, Pune City Subdistrict, Pune, Maharashtra, 411001, India
pune.audio_guide_text: The Raja Dinkar Kelkar Museum houses a treasure trove of Indian folk art, tools, and curiosities. Each exhibit tells a story of everyday life across centuries.

pune.name: Vishrambaug Wada
pune.description: Vishrambaag Wada, a mansion situated at central Pune's Thorale Bajirao Road, was the residence of Peshwa Baji Rao II, the last Peshwa of Maratha confederacy, in early 19th century. The 20,000 sq.ft. wada presently houses a post office on its ground f
pune.address: Vishrambaug Wada, R. B. Kumthekar Marg, Narayan Peth, Pune, Pune City Subdistrict, Pune, Maharashtra, 411001, India
pune.audio_guide_text: Vishrambaug Wada reflects the opulence of the late Peshwa era with its lofty arches and European touches. Explore the historic halls that once hosted royal gatherings.

pune.name: Shivneri Fort
pune.description: Shivneri Fort (known as Killa) (Marathi pronunciation: [ʃiʋneɾiː]) is an ancient military fortification located near Junnar in Pune district in Maharashtra, India. It is the birthplace of Chatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, the  founder of Maratha Kingdom.
pune.address: Shivneri Fort, Junnar -Darya Ghat  Road, Junnar, Pune, Maharashtra, 410502, India
pune.audio_guide_text: Perched atop a rugged hill, Shivneri Fort marks the birthplace of the legendary Maratha king Shivaji. Trek its stone steps and soak in sweeping vistas of the Sahyadri range.

pune.name: Malshej Ghat
pune.description: A scenic mountain pass in the Western Ghats, Malshej Ghat is famed for its mist‑laden valleys, waterfalls, and abundant birdlife, especially during monsoon. It offers trekking trails and breathtaking viewpoints.
pune.address: Malshej Ghat MTDC Resort, NH222, Patakwadi, Pargaon, Murbad Subdistrict, Thane, Maharashtra, India
pune.audio_guide_text: Malshej Ghat unfolds a tapestry of misty hills, cascading waterfalls, and vibrant avian spectacles. Let the fresh mountain air revitalize you as you explore its natural trails.
